note: 6.3.0 candidate receipt. One new public default-profile tool, add_chart, inserts native charts: a data series set is compiled to ECMA-376 chartML (render-verified MVP types bar/line/pie; anything else is refused with CHART_UNSUPPORTED — no silent approximation), stored as a Chart/chartN.xml part registered in no manifest (the real-Hancom contract), and anchored with <hp:chart chartIDRef>. Real Hancom draws the chart from the chartML alone — the OLE fallback and pre-rendered images real Hancom also writes are deliberately not generated. Placement covers appended paragraphs, existing paragraphs, table cells, and inline (treat_as_char).

inputParameters.name: series
inputParameters.description: [{"name": str, "values": [number,...]}]; values length must match categories.

coreDependency.capability: hwpx.HwpxDocument.add_chart (experimental contract) — chartML part storage behind the real-Hancom hp:chart anchor
coreDependency.failClosed: Unsupported chart types/shapes raise typed CHART_UNSUPPORTED before any write; malformed data raises CHART_INPUT_INVALID; invalid targets raise CHART_TARGET_INVALID / TABLE_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE / PARAGRAPH_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE. The candidate distribution requires python-hwpx>=5.3.0, the first public core with the chart part/anchor primitive.

proof: Holding every existing tool fixed, the canonical payload delta is confined to the dependency/version floors and one added public default-profile mutating tool, add_chart (edit domain). No tool is removed, renamed, reclassified, or moved between profiles; every existing input/output schema is unchanged. The anchor/part emission follows the hp:chart contract reverse-engineered from a real Hancom-authored document, and every MVP chart type was verified by pixel against a live Hancom render oracle, including the OLE-free authored output.
